# Flow: activity from a governance decision
Load when: decision row 9 of SKILL.md (create the activity a governance thread decided)

## Preconditions
1. `prepare_issue_draft_from_governance_thread` needs an LPM API key with profile full, requirements or custom (not planning, not connectors). Missing → core rule 2.
2. `readyToCreate` is true for ANY resolved or closed thread, whatever its outcome: always check `thread.decisionOutcome.type` too.
3. `create_issue` is not idempotent: create once; re-list before any retry.

## Steps
1. `prepare_issue_draft_from_governance_thread`(projectId, threadId, messageLimitCount=100) → keep `readyToCreate`, `thread.decisionOutcome.type`, `draft`.
2. Continue only if `readyToCreate` is true AND `thread.decisionOutcome.type` == "create-activity"; otherwise STOP → `lpm-governance-decisions`.
3. `list_issues`(projectId, limitCount=100), loop `nextCursor` while `hasMore` → `draft.title` equal (lowercase, trimmed) to an existing title → ask "Skip, or create anyway?".
4. `create_issue`(projectId, title=draft.title, description=draft.description) [A]; with an API key also send requirementId=draft.requirementId and baselineId=draft.baselineId when not null → issueId after "ID: ".
5. "Requirement not found" / "Baseline not found" (nothing was created) → resend once without requirementId and baselineId; report the missing link under Pending.
6. Verify: `get_issue`(projectId, issueId) → `title` equals `draft.title`; `requirementId` equals the one sent.
7. Hand off to `lpm-governance-decisions` to link the thread to the new issue (action target type `issue`, target id = issueId); the link stays Pending until that skill confirms it.

## Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| `readyToCreate` false | STOP → `lpm-governance-decisions`: the decision is not taken |
| outcome is not `create-activity` (no-action, derive-requirement, propose-change-set, clarification, publication-note) | STOP → `lpm-governance-decisions`: governance did not decide to create an activity |
| the draft title already exists | "Skip, or create anyway?" |

## Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| `create_issue` | `get_issue`(projectId, issueId) | title and requirementId equal the draft |

## Report fields
Scope (project, threadId), created issue id and title, requirementId / baselineId bound or missing, traceability link pending with `lpm-governance-decisions`, Next.
